Unique solvability for large \bar\sigma may follow from smallness, but exponential convergence of the computable density requires the additional exponentially small remainder, source-defect, and tail estimates; the introductory sentence says the algebraic estimate alone immediately implies exponential convergence.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: Taking the plus trace and using \(\gamma_+w_\phi=\phi\) gives

issues.failure_explanation: With the stated representation u=SL q - DL \phi and the plus-trace jump for the double-layer written as -1/2 I + K, the plus trace gives (1/2 I - K)\phi = S q, not (1/2 I + K)\phi = S q.  Equivalently, the factorization (1/2 I + K)\phi = S \Lambda\phi uses the lower-trace jump for the plus trace.  Thus the displayed exact BIE operator A_{\sigma,N}^0 has the wrong sign on the double-layer contribution.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: No complete source-supported repair identified; at minimum, a repair must correct the double-layer sign in the derivation of the exact BIE and re-derive or re-verify all dependent equivalence, stability, and convergence claims under a consistent jump convention.
issues.overall_effect: The central exact PML-Green BIE is false as written, so its equivalence with the PML PDE, its stability, the exact convergence theorem, and all later computable/nearest-image convergence results that rely on it are unreliable.
issues.title: Exact PML-Green BIE has wrong sign in the double-layer part
issues.why_classification: The defect changes the central operator being analyzed and invalidates the main chain of results; no comparable source-supported resolution preserving the stated exact BIE exists.

The exact density \phi^\sigma_0 is only shown to satisfy a polynomially growing Y_R bound, while the family norm takes a supremum over \bar\sigma of the unweighted Y_R component. diagnostic_evidence.quote: The present analysis does not require a well-posedness theory for \eqref{eq:complex-scaled-bie}.

issues.failure_explanation: The paper states without proof that the trace of the formal complex-scaled continuation satisfies the untruncated stretched free-space BIE on the whole infinite impedance boundary.  This is a nontrivial assertion about a free-space BIE in an impedance half-space (with surface-wave/background Green-function structure), and the source neither proves it nor establishes the needed analytic continuation or well-posedness.
